meta.title: District crop exposure × drought — OAE amphoe surveys × OAE SPEI (obj #1)
meta.label: MEASURED planted areas (OAE remote-sensing amphoe surveys + OAE Zone-6 unified data; every row cites its source PDF) × MODELLED drought (OAE SPEI, ERA5-Land, 2026-06). Name-joined; unmatched rows counted below, never guessed. Do NOT sum across the two sources — different survey vintages.

sources.national: OAE HQ Geo-Informatics Center (ศูนย์สารสนเทศการเกษตร) nationwide satellite standing/planted-area-by-amphoe survey PDFs, ALL 77 provinces attempted, extracted from the copies mirrored on zone10.oae.go.th
sources.zone6: OAE Zone 6 (สศท.6) เอกภาพ ระดับอำเภอ crop comparison PDFs, per-crop, 2 most recent years each
sources.drought: MODELLED index, not a raw meteorological observation and not a disaster declaration. SPEI (Standardized Precipitation-Evapotranspiration Index) computed by OAE from ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated reanalysis climate data (ECMWF Climate Reanalysis, served via Google Earth Engine Data Catalog) — i.e. MODELLED/derived from measured global reanalysis precipitation + temperature, aggregated to a monthly mean per amphoe (Thai district). This IS the exact 'OAE SPEI by district' product the user named: OAE is the publisher of record on data.go.th, and the metric is genuinely SPEI, genuinely at amphoe resolution, genuinely dated. It is NOT: (a) a Thai ground-station-only product (the underlying grid is a global reanalysis, downscaled/aggregated to district polygons — so treat as MODELLED, same provenance tier as the pipeline's existing HDX rainfall proxy, one step more official since OAE is the compiling government agency), (b) a DDPM drought-disaster declaration (no administrative/legal weight), (c) a multi-month per-district history (see gaps below).

meta.coverage_note: cassava: no South section in the source PDF (structural); oil palm source corrupted at origin (not recoverable); Zone-6 adds 16 Eastern crops incl. durian/mangosteen.
